newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Islamabad has reservation about the proposed sub-regional cooperation under the aegis of SAARC, a Pakistani diplomat said in Dhaka on Friday.
A Belgian, Luc Chris, who was arrested at the Dhaka airport Thursday night with an antique stone statue, was produced before the court.
Finance Minister S A M S Kibria said he would place a proposal before the cabinet soon seeking approval for raising the prices of petroleum products and fertiliser.
Bangladesh has been accepted as a full member of the UN Special Committee on Peacekeeping Operations.
Government has taken up projects to re-excavate a total of 59 rivers, tributaries and canals across the country in next three years.
The Worlk Bank has suggested a thorough reform in Bangladesh rural financing to achieve desired economic growth.
Country's tea production totalled 37.08 million kg and exports stood at 19.57 million kg in the first seven months of the current 1996-97 fiscal year (July-January).
Singer, a leading multinational company, has decided to set up an electronic plant and a furniture factory as part of its business expansion plan in Bangladesh. REUTER
